title: Kelowna Top 5 Food Tour with Drinks
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Calling all foodies...welcome to the VIVID Food Tour! Looking for the ultimate downtown Kelowna food experience? Have we got a treat for you! Showcasing the finest culinary experiences from Kelowna chefs and restaurants, our Kelowna food tour will have your taste buds tingling.

Fully guided and offering 5 tasty stops throughout the heart of the downtown and cultural district of Kelowna, the focus of this tour is all about the food. A proper food tour done right with substantial portion sizes, you won't go home hungry!

Guests will be treated to 5 authentic Kelowna food experiences including Mexican Tacos, wood fired Neopolitan Pizza, traditional Tennessee BBQ, Asian fusion, and a modern, upscale twist on familiar favourites! This Kelowna food tour also includes pairings of 2 alcoholic beverages curated to enhance the experience (hope everyone likes margaritas)!

Don't forget to pair your adventure with one of VIVID's popular wine tours - what a way to uncover local treasures!
